cards.claim: m2 pages 3–4 Match Type item 1 asks to match four polynomials to roots in Column II.
cards.quote: In Column-I polynomial is given and Column-II root of the polynomial is given. Then match Column-I with Column-II accordingly.

options: Column II: (A) x=1; (B) x=-1; (C) x=2; (D) x=-2

cards.claim: The printed Match Type answer key gives item 1 as (i)-(B,C), (ii)-(C), (iii)-(A), (iv)-(B).
m2 pages 3–4 Match Type item 2 asks to match four polynomials to factors in Column II.
cards.quote: In Column-I polynomial is given and Column-II factor of the polynomial is given. Then match Column-I with Column-II accordingly.

cards.claim: The printed Match Type answer key gives item 2 as (i)-(A,B,C), (ii)-(A,B), (iii)-(A,D), (iv)-(A,C).
cards.quote: Match Type Questions 2. (i)-(A, B, C), (ii)-(A, B), (iii)-(A, D), (iv)-(A, C)

cards.claim: m2 page 4 Match Type item 3 asks to match expressions to polynomial names based on degree and number of terms.
cards.quote: In Column-I polynomial is given and in Column-II name of the polynomial on the basis of degree and terms is given. Then match Column-I with Column-II accordingly.

options: Column II: (A) Quadratic; (B) Linear; (C) Binomial; (D) Monomial

cards.claim: The printed Match Type answer key gives item 3 as (i)-(B,D), (ii)-(B,C), (iii)-(A,C), (iv)-(A).
cards.quote: Match Type Questions 3. (i)-(B, D), (ii)-(B, C), (iii)-(A, C), (iv)-(A)

cards.claim: m2 page 4 Match Type item 4 asks to match four algebraic expressions to their factorisations.
cards.quote: In Column-I an algebraic expression is given and in Column-II factorization is given. Then match Column-I with Column-II accordingly.

options: Column I: (i) a³-1/a³+4; (ii) a³+1/a³-2; (iii) a⁴+a²+1; (iv) a⁴+5a²+9

cards.claim: The printed Match Type answer key gives item 4 as (i)-(D), (ii)-(A), (iii)-(C), (iv)-(B).
m2 page 4 Match Type item 5 asks to match dividend/divisor pairs to their remainders.

options: Column I: (i) p(x)=2x⁴-6x³+2x²-x+2, g(x)=x+2; (ii) p(x)=x⁴-3x²+4, g(x)=x-2; (iii) f(x)=9x³-3x²+x-5, g(x)=x-2/3; (iv) f(x)=x³+4x²-3x+10, g(x)=x+4

cards.claim: The printed Match Type answer key gives item 5 as (i)-(C), (ii)-(A), (iii)-(B), (iv)-(D).
